rules: Authored before any scoring run against this set, after the earlier-failure tool-result note that followed the holdout12 gate (undisclosed tool failures after a successful follow-up ticket; crude fabricated-claim patterns and weak answer checks fixed in this set); never use it to tune prompts, retrieval, policies or scorer thresholds.
A run on this set is a gate. Any edit to holdout13.json changes the hash and must be a deliberate, reviewed re-freeze with a new date and a note here.
Disjoint from development.json, evaluation.json and holdout through holdout12 (ids, domains, business questions).
limitations: 45 cases in 5 small-business domains, English only, single provider/model per run: not a general measure of answer quality.
Pattern/substring checks are a proxy; a human rubric review of a sample is still required (docs/evidence/l1.4). noDenial cases assume the case's own knowledge is silent on the asked offering.
supersedes: holdout12 (consumed 2026-11-03: valid run, failed 4 thresholds; 2 real undisclosed tool failures, the rest case-pattern false positives).
